requirement_evidence.evidence: BoundEngine binds to ReferenceOwner and TrustedAnchorReceipt. Targets class c* = receipt.winner and enforces exactly 11 competitor classes j in 0..11, j != c*, without duplicates. Verified by test_c01_bound_engine_receipt_binding_and_competitor_integrity.

Implemented actual-graph IBP through SmallCNN1D (15 layers). Separates NumericalMode.VALIDATED (using Higham backward error bounds and outward rounding, yielding NumericalStatus.VALIDATED_FLOAT32_ENCLOSURE) from NumericalMode.ORDINARY_FLOAT (standard float64 operations yielding NumericalStatus.NOT_ESTABLISHED). Verified by test_c02_separation_of_validated_and_ordinary_float_paths.

Computes paired MarginMethod.DIRECT_MARGIN (fused Wc - Wj) and MarginMethod.SEPARATE_LOGITS from identical hidden box activations and perturbation budgets. Preserves full 11-competitor vectors in BoundResult.lower_margins. Verified by test_c03_paired_direct_margin_and_separate_logits.

Ablation across 30 validation windows confirmed H07 and H08: at eps=1e-4, direct_margin achieves 70% positive rate vs 3% for separate_logits (mean margin gain +4.4209, 30/30 windows tighter) due to canceling shared hidden features. At eps=1e-3, multi-layer interval wrapping causes margin collapse to 0% positive rate, confirming that IBP is an incomplete relaxation without claiming completeness. Verified by test_c04_h07_equal_hidden_cancellation_and_h08_wrapping.

Fail-closed input rejection: raises ProfileMismatchError on non-canonical profiles, StaleAnchorError on checkpoint/preprocessing mismatch, UnsupportedDomainError on inverted endpoints (lo > hi), and NonFiniteBoundError on NaN/Inf inputs. Distinguishes inconclusive bounds from concrete counterexamples. Verified by test_c05_rejection_of_invalid_inputs_fail_closed.

Recorded bound_ms, total_ms, method_id, and source hashes in BoundResult and capability artifacts. Reuses supplied TrustedAnchorReceipt to avoid duplicate anchor inference. Verified by test_c06_timings_metadata_and_no_duplicate_inference.

Evaluated ablation strictly on frozen validation split windows (windows_with_split.parquet, split='val') across eps in {0.0, 1e-5, 1e-4, 1e-3}. Zero test set evaluation or tuning. Verified by test_c07_validation_split_ablation_and_artifacts.

scientific_dispositions: Confirms H04/H05: Actual-graph IBP provides a mathematically sound lower bound on competitor margins under Higham backward error bounds.
Confirms H07: Direct-margin eliminates equal-hidden pessimism, retaining 70% positive coverage at eps=1e-4 where separate logits collapses to 3%.
Confirms H08/H09: Multi-layer interval wrapping causes margin collapse at eps=1e-3, confirming IBP incompleteness without false counterexample claims.
limitations: Actual-graph IBP is an incomplete relaxation; margin collapse at epsilon >= 1e-3 is an artifact of interval wrapping across 3 convolutional layers.
Certified regional reuse requires tighter bounding methods (e.g. CROWN in W4-014 or correlation-preserving bounds in W4-017).
